mode_note: dry_run logs what WOULD be routed and touches no agent. live refers messages to the owning domain (record only - nothing executes from an email) and tells the principal. Switched by the principal, never by code.
routable_note: Legal: court filings, service notices. Accounting: payment confirmations, receipts. Grow: the plants. Anything else, or anything two of these claim, is HELD for the principal.

auto_fetch.note: The principal's exception 2026-10-09 ('Auto fetch yes'): Anansi fetches the Mars Hydro THP export link and hands the CSV to Grow. ONLY when the sender is marshydro-noreply@notice00.marshydro.eu with SPF, DKIM and DMARC all pass, the link is exactly mars-pro.api.lgledsolutions.com/api/common/download/file/v1?uuid=<hex>, and the download is a CSV under 25 MB whose header carries the THP columns. Anything else is held. Independent of the listener's dry_run mode by his decision; 'off' disables it.

principal_channel.note: The principal's own mail (2026-10-09 - Base44, logged into his Gmail, reads Anansi's mail and replies through it). Treated like a typed message ONLY from the NOTIFY_TO address with SPF, DKIM and DMARC all pass. dry_run: log the reply text and where it WOULD route - nothing is recorded (routing only; the write path is never called). live: route through process_request and email back what was recorded, subject tagged [MycOS ack]; a reply to an ack is never acknowledged (loop guard). Switched by the principal.
